lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Tonight at the arena I'm gonna pin you one-two-three and take the world championship belt, kid!

lines.speaker: peaux
lines.text: Not before my piledriver and a steel chair put you through the announce table, old man.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The crowd came to see "The Hammer" win, and the Hammer always wins!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Hulk Hogan taught me everything. Let's give the fans a great show and shake hands after.
